name: Kneaders European Fruit Tart with Vanilla Custard (Warning)
whyItWorks: A shortbread butter tart shell filled with rich dairy custard and topped with raw whole raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, and kiwi. Raw whole blackberry and raspberry seeds are hard mechanical irritants.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Seed & Dairy Warning: Avoid raw seed-heavy tarts. Choose a slice of plain cinnamon swirl bread or sugar cookie instead.
